findings.title: Doctor has no graphics availability detector
findings.reproduction: Call hardware_fingerprint() with any host: gpu and graphics_render_probe always equal NOT_RUN; inspect function for unconditional constants. doctor() never invokes any graphics detector.
findings.impact: Required Phase1 graphics capability/readiness classification cannot distinguish unavailable, supported headless rendering, or unknown environment.
findings.fix: Implement bounded read-only graphics/headless availability observations with explicit UNKNOWN/BLOCKED reasons; keep actual render qualification separate and require native render evidence for PASS.

findings.title: Optional interactive MCP discovery and execution-mode matrix are incomplete
findings.reproduction: doctor data.integrations contains only blender_mcp_cli, unity_mcp_cli, host_sessions=NOT_RUN, offline_core=true. Search workforce.discovery and knowledge.availability: host binary/API receipts exist but no registered interactive MCP inventory or offline/assisted matrix.
findings.impact: Installed host plugins without conventional CLI names are invisible; consumers cannot select assisted mode from an explicit availability matrix.
findings.fix: Accept bounded host-supplied read-only MCP discovery evidence and expose explicit offline/assisted per-operation states, preserving core offline availability and UNKNOWN when host inventory is absent.

findings.title: Section6.3 workspace lock and artifact metadata are incomplete
findings.reproduction: rg polyforge.lock.json polyforge returns no match; current registry producer in blender/adapter.py:384 emits artifact_id/relative_path/hash/bytes/input_digest/validation_status/toolchain only. Planning-state artifacts omit project/run/stage/timestamp as well. Per-run input.json and journal recover much context, but no unified lock of canonical manifest, tool/package versions and seeds exists.
findings.impact: A consumer must reconstruct environment/ownership from heterogeneous enclosing files rather than consume required canonical lock/artifact contract; complete schema guarantees cannot be checked independently.
findings.fix: Define complete registry/lock schema and shared publisher, explicitly preserve project/run/stage/kind/time and upstream inputs, and write a single coherent version/package/seed/manifest snapshot. Keep absolute locations only local and safe paths published.
findings.qualification: This is partial required metadata/output, not lack of hashing/provenance. Run ID is inferable from artifact_id/path and toolchain/seed identities are already captured per run.
